verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management platform. Its AI Teammates are coordination agents, not coding agents, so restoring an AI coding agent's session to a version-history checkpoint is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana ships a coding agent or session checkpointing that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
